blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has given taxpayers until the end of the year to enroll in its enhanced electronic documentary stamp tax system (eDST), laying down clarifications on the requirements and procedures for the shift to the improved platform. Under Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 107-2026, the BIR requires covered taxpayers to enroll by December 31, 2026. Newly registered taxpayers must enroll within 90 days from their registration date.
